Why Choose Services Plus?

The Insecticides Act of 1968 together with the Insecticides Rules of 1971 establishes the legal framework for issuing pesticide licenses. The law controls all pesticide-related processes from production to sales to distribution and usage in order to maintain public safety and protect the environment and support sustainable agriculture.

All companies that provide pest control services or engage in pesticide trading or distribution activities must obtain their Pest control business license. The introduction of digital systems across all government agencies has created an easier process for obtaining Pest control licenses through online applications.

Services Plus takes care of all aspects that clients need to complete in order to get their Pest control license online through application. The team manages all documentation needs while they check compliance requirements and communicate with the official regulatory bodies.

A pesticide license represents an official government permit that grants permission to individuals and businesses for the following activities.
Manufacture insecticides or pesticides.
Sell pesticides in retail or wholesale.
Distribute pesticides.
Commercial pesticide storage activities.
Pest control service operation.
Commercial pesticide activities require valid Pest control business licenses because they ensure safe chemical handling according to established safety regulations.

The online system for Pest control license applications streamlines business application submission through electronic methods, which eliminate the need for physical paperwork and enhance application processing efficiency.
